Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning financial viability and impact review of certain transportation projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to financial viability and impact review of certaintransportation projects; and adding new sections to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall reconvene the expert review panel appointedunder RCW 47.01.400, for the purpose of updating the work that waspreviously completed by the panel on the Alaskan Way viaduct andSeattle Seawall replacement project and the state route number 520bridge replacement and HOV project. The expert review panel mustreport updated findings and recommendations as described in RCW47.01.400 to the joint transportation committee, the office offinancial management, and the governor by September 1, 2010. Uponreceipt of the expert review panel's updated findings andrecommendations, the governor must make a determination of whether thefinancial plans for the Alaskan Way viaduct and Seattle Seawallreplacement project and the state route number 520 bridge replacementand HOV project are feasible and sufficient to complete the projects asdescribed in their supplemental draft environmental impact statements.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The King county executive shall facilitate a resolution to thefinal project design for the state route number 520 bridge replacementand HOV project by preparing a plan for addressing the impacts of thestate route number 520 bridge replacement and HOV project onsurrounding cities, neighborhoods, parks, and institutions of highereducation. In evaluating the project's impacts, the county executiveshall give great weight to the concerns of cities, neighborhoods, andinstitutions of higher education impacted by design proposals on eitherside of Lake Washington. (2) The legislature intends that the plan will allow acomprehensive approach to mitigating the impacts of the project andthat the county executive presents the plan to the department. Theplan must be fiscally constrained in its review of mitigation optionsand recommend only those strategies that can be implemented within theproject budget amount as identified in RCW 47.01.418(2)(a). (3) The county executive shall convene an advisory committee tohelp finalize the plan; however, the county executive has finalapproval of the plan. The county executive must designaterepresentation from the community council or governing body of eachneighborhood and city impacted by the state route number 520 bridgereplacement and HOV project and representation from the Washington parkarboretum to serve on the advisory committee to guide the planningprocess and for plan preparation. The University of Washington andsecretary of transportation shall each designate a representative toserve on the advisory committee. The department shall providetechnical assistance for the advisory committee. (4) The department shall not commence construction on any part ofthe state route number 520 bridge replacement and HOV project untilagreements have been reached with the county executive that areconsistent with the plan.
